title: Hickory DNS through 0.26.0-alpha.1 DNSSEC Validation Bypass via Ancestor-Delegation NSEC3
description: CVE-2026-123595 is a vulnerability in Hickory DNS version 4.0 that allows DNSSEC validation bypass via ancestor-delegation NSEC3 records. This flaw could undermine the integrity of DNSSEC validation, potentially allowing attackers to bypass security checks. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided.
